name: SQL Injection in Login Form
desc: A SQL injection vulnerability was found in the login form's username parameter. An attacker can bypass authentication or extract sensitive data from the database.
resolution: Use parameterized queries or prepared statements. Implement input validation.

name: Remote Code Execution via Deserialization
desc: Insecure deserialization of untrusted data allows remote code execution.
resolution: Implement strict type checking during deserialization. Use allowlisting for permitted classes.

name: SMB Signing Not Required
desc: SMB signing is not required on this host, making it vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks.
resolution: Enable mandatory SMB signing via Group Policy.

name: MS17-010 EternalBlue
desc: This system is vulnerable to the MS17-010 vulnerability (EternalBlue) which allows remote code execution.

name: Default Telnet Credentials
desc: The telnet service accepts default credentials (admin/admin).
resolution: Disable telnet and use SSH. If telnet is required, change default credentials.

name: vsftpd Backdoor
desc: The installed version of vsftpd (2.3.4) contains a backdoor that can be triggered by sending a :) in the username.
resolution: Upgrade vsftpd to a patched version.

name: Weak SSL/TLS Cipher Suites
desc: The server supports weak cipher suites that could be exploited.
resolution: Disable weak cipher suites and enable only TLS 1.2+ with strong ciphers.

name: Missing HTTP Security Headers
desc: Several recommended HTTP security headers are missing.
resolution: Add X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, and Content-Security-Policy headers.

name: Information Disclosure via Server Banner
desc: The server discloses version information in HTTP headers.
resolution: Configure server to hide version information.

name: Vulnerability Without Service
desc: A host-level vulnerability detected without specific service association.
